palette.hint: Drag a block onto the canvas to add it. Connect blocks by dragging from the bottom dot to the next block's top dot.

inspector.selectBlock: Select a block to edit its settings.

analytics.title: Analytics

danger.subtitle: Irreversible actions. Proceed with care.
danger.explanation: Permanently deletes your user, sessions, organization memberships, connected Instagram tokens, flows, contacts and history. This cannot be undone. See <dataDeletionLink>the data deletion page</dataDeletionLink> for the full scope and retention policy.
danger.confirmBody: Type your email {email} and your current password. This will delete your account, sessions, organization memberships, connected Instagram tokens, flows and contacts. The action cannot be undone.
danger.fillFields: Fill in your email and password
